newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan central bank injects T$38.37 bln in funds.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan central bank injects T$38.37 bln in funds.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank on Tuesday injected T$38.37 billion worth of funds into the banking system through open market operations, a central bank official said.

The bank typically executes open market operations through bills finance companies, using a range of qualified securities instruments offered by interested financial institutions, but before Tuesday had not done so since late February.
In an unusual twist for Tuesday's injection, the qualified instruments were limited to central bank negotiable certificates of deposit. The term was within-one-day.
The bank, contacted directly by interested financial institutions, purchased back T$38.37 billion in NCDs offered by financial institutions with a single yield at 6.0 percent, the official said.
The institutions have the option of repurchasing the instruments within one day of their issue, the official said.
